switch_on: only blank content (runaway newlines) for nonblank_stall_seconds
no_switch: a complete answer whose JSON does not fit the schema (model output; the product repair path decides)

selection.rule: providers passing all 4 probe requests, by fewest failures then median time to first non-blank content (Near AI, CoreWeave, Chutes); Reka and Parasail added 4th/5th on the user request for 4-5 providers: they passed 3 of 4 and failed only the stored request on which both wrote runaway newlines (the case this fallback catches). DeepInfra and Cloudflare were not added: their long answers did not finish in 180 s (slow output).
selection.thresholds: first non-blank 60 s = min(60, max(30, 3 x 54.057 s largest first non-blank among passing requests: Chutes long answer)); stall 60 s as frozen in ADR-1512

authorization.text: 공급자의 문제처럼 답이 없다거나 하면 공급자 다르게해서 질문날리게해(이거 다음 실험할때도 그렇게해 기억해놔) / 한 4~5개 정도 선정해놔서 문제 생기면 교체하게 공급자에 문제 없는지 검토 미리해서 유명한 공급자만 선별해서 갈아끼워서 바로 질문할수 있께 해줘
